threepl.netlist

Class Ports

  • java.lang.Object
    • threepl.netlist.Ports

  • public class Ports
extends java.lang.Object
    This class represents the names of input, output and 3-state output ports of an element. In each of the 3 port maps in class Element the key is the pin name and the corresponding value is class Port. 'width' is the number of pins in the port. 'arrayformat' indicates the required form of ports which are arrays of pins. arrayformat=0 indicates a non-array (single) pin. arrayformat=1 indicates a port where array members are expanded into discrete pins of the form A0, A1 etc. arrayformat=2 indicates a port where cell ports are declared as port arrays and instances use the array 'member' form.
